items.t: Said her legislative agenda is focused on policies that fuel economic growth and ensure fair opportunities for everyone.
items.q: My legislative agenda is focused on policies that fuel economic growth and ensure fair opportunities for everyone.

items.t: Said that guaranteeing personal finance education in Maine schools will help students grow into independent adults capable of making sound financial decisions.
items.q: If we guarantee that Maine schools provide their students with personal finance education, then we will help then grow into fully independent adults capable of making sound financial decisions

items.t: Said a law ensures a nutritious meal follows the child no matter where they learn and lets providers focus on caring for kids.
items.q: This law fixes that by making sure a nutritious meal follows the child, no matter where they learn, and gives providers the ability to focus on caring for kids instead of figuring out how to cover the cost of feeding them.

items.t: Said a child care bill reduces what families are asked to pay and brings more stability to providers.
items.q: By reducing what families are asked to pay and bringing more stability to providers, this bill takes a meaningful step toward a system that is more affordable, more sustainable, and better able to serve our communities.

items.t: Said a storm preparedness bill takes steps to safeguard communities from storms and gives homeowners tools to build more resilient homes.
items.q: we are not only taking proactive steps to safeguard our communities from the increasing threat of storms but also ensuring that homeowners have the tools and resources they need to build stronger, more resilient homes

record.t: Served as President of the Senate.
record.q: Matthea Elisabeth Larsen Daughtry, President of the Senate

record.t: Sponsored LD 1284, "An Act to Require Personal Finance to be Taught as a Separate Course to Obtain a High School Diploma," which the Maine Senate gave initial approval.
record.q: the Maine Senate gave initial approval to a bill from Sen. Mattie Daughtry, D-Brunswick. LD 1284 , “An Act to Require Personal Finance to be Taught as a Separate Course to Obtain a High School Diploma,”

record.t: Sponsored a bill with Rep. Kristen Cloutier and attended its signing ceremony.
record.q: after taking a congratulatory call from the White House and attending the signing ceremony. She sponsored the bill with Rep. Kristen Cloutier, D-Lewiston.

record.t: Sponsored legislation designed to enhance emergency planning at all levels of government.
record.q: The legislation, sponsored by Senate President Mattie Daughtry, House Speaker Ryan Fecteau, Senate Republican Leader Trey Stewart, and House Minority Leader Billy Bob Faulkingham, is designed to enhance emergency planning at all levels of government

record.t: Cosponsored a bill introduced by the Governor while serving as Senate Assistant Majority Leader.
record.q: It is cosponsored by Senate President Troy Jackson and Speaker of the House Rachel Talbot Ross, as well as Senate Majority Leader Eloise Vitelli, Senate Assistant Majority Leader Mattie Daughtry

record.t: Introduced LD 2064, "The Apple Act," on which a new grant program for free meals was based.
record.q: introduced by Senate President Daughtry in February based on findings from her statewide Support Kids, Support Maine Child Care Listening Tour
